description: The İzmir river-flood risk package was prepared under the CLIMAAX project for İzmir Province, Türkiye. Zenodo provides a public Jupyter notebook and archives of building depths, economic damage layers, population exposure, source exposure layers and critical-facility impacts under CC BY 4.0. The description names 10-, 50-, 100- and 500-year flood return periods for a baseline and RCP 8.5 scenario. Buildings have intersected water depths and depth-damage estimates; schools and hospitals appear in critical-infrastructure maps. These layers can set exposure and loss benchmarks for provincial flood simulations or emergency-service scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this combined İzmir release. A limitation is that projected damage follows the chosen hazard maps and damage curves, not observed future losses. The page does not list raster resolution, facility completeness or uncertainty intervals. The notebook and archives were not downloaded or run, and no return-period estimate was independently checked.
name: River Flood Risk Assessment for İzmir (Türkiye): Building Damage, Exposed Population, and Infrastructure Impacts (CRIZ-ERS)
